messages:
Morgan (Finance): Morning  Feb invoice shows an unexpected $21,400 GPU charge under hosted-models tagged customer=unassigned, team=null. Need owner mapping for chargeback before COB.

billing-bot: Alert: gpu_cost anomaly project=hosted-models spike detected 2026-02-20. See /alerts/179001.

Drew (Infra): Can you paste the raw row? Untagged jobs typically leak into the shared bucket.

Morgan (Finance): Row: `2026-02-20 hosted-models gpu A100 $21,400 tags: customer=null,team=null,job=prod-embeds-run-07`

Kai (ML): That job name looks like our production embedding job. We had a staggered rollout around 02/19. I think a canary used a reserved template by mistake.

Drew (Infra): Running quick lookup:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --filter "job==prod-embeds-run-07" --group-by template,instance_type
```
It shows two instances on `reserved-highmem` totaling $18.6k and one preemptible at $2.8k.

Sam (Sales): If this is customer-facing (Prod for ACME), Sales may have a POC/paid support line to absorb some costs. Ill check the contract.

Morgan (Finance): Provisional split: Prod (Kai) $12,900, Customer POC/credit $6,700, Platform overhead $1,800. I'll file FIN-8015 with these allocations; auto-approve up to $7k credit application.

Drew (Infra): Short-term fix: enforce `--team` at submit and warn on `reserved` templates for jobs with `prod` in the name. Also added an alert to email owners for any job spending > $5k/day.

billing-bot: Ticket FIN-8015 created by Morgan (Finance)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-8015

Kai (ML): Confirmed the mistaken reserved runs. We'll absorb our portion and follow up with Sales for POC credit. Will add a pre-submit checklist to the repo.

Morgan (Finance): Thanks  closing provisional allocation. Update FIN-8015 when Sales confirms credit. :white_check_mark:
